title: Complex Wavelet-Based Sinogram Segmentation for Metal Artifact Reduction in Cone-Beam CT
summary: Metal objects pose a significant challenge in cone-beam computed tomography, as their strong and energy-dependent X-ray attenuation leads to inconsistent projections and severe streaking and shading artifacts in reconstructed images. These artifacts degrade image quality and limit the reliability of subsequent medical analysis.
